Lore

Born from pixels.
Buried in orbit.

ARTGONAUTS is a 10,000-piece collection of skeletal explorers wandering through a corrupted digital cosmos. Every character is shaped by unique combinations of bones, cloaks, crowns, visors, relics, artifacts, and cosmic backgrounds.

Each Artgonaut carries its own relics, scars, colors, and story from somewhere beyond the known map. No two journeys are exactly the same.

“Some explore. Some collect. Some never return.”
